# Synthetic telemetry fixtures

`adsblol-synthetic.json` was authored for SkyTrace tests. All identifiers,
callsigns, positions and values are synthetic and do not describe actual flights.
It follows the public v2 wire format, with an epoch-millisecond snapshot time.
Original fixture content is covered by the repository's MIT license.

Real provider captures must remain under ignored `data/`, with retrieval and
ODbL attribution metadata. Do not silently replace this fixture with live data.
